predecessor.diagnosis: All 18 functional centers, including three plug_in centers, were available, but the provider exposed zero door 3DOD anchors.
predecessor.information_change: Let a local regular same-action lattice be its own carrier when object-box and explicit context carriers are absent. Keep clustering, lattice, active-view thresholds, roster, and task prefilter unchanged.

source.dataset: SceneFun3D train split plus ARKitScenes low-resolution ARKit camera trajectory
source.camera_pose_frame: ARKit camera-to-world after official trajectory inversion

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first scene containing an admissible self-carrier active-view opportunity.

frozen_algorithm.view_selection: Among real trajectory poses that contain every lattice candidate inside the frozen normalized frustum, maximize horizontal span, then minimize median depth, then choose earliest timestamp.
frozen_algorithm.left_right_authority: Camera-frame projected x coordinate from the selected real pose; smaller x is left.
frozen_algorithm.baseline: All candidates in the admitted local same-action lattice remain set-valued.

forbidden_after_source_access: read description annot_id values or target membership
choose the lattice, component, camera pose, or polarity using selector output or evaluator score
change lattice radius, pitch, residual, frustum, depth, span, dominance, or view-ranking thresholds
merge disconnected same-action centers or use sibling target order
reorder candidates or skip the first eligible scene
claim_boundary: Outcome-blind source admission for a carrier-free local functional lattice plus a real-pose active view. It uses public task text, privileged functional labels/centers, and camera trajectory but no target IDs or selector outcomes. Passing does not establish RGB proposal quality, online view reachability, tracking, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
